mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(MENU_ID) FROM WHERE MENU_PARENT_ID IS NOT NULL START WITH MENU_ID = '0' CONNECT BY PRIOR MENU_ID = MENU_PARENT_ID ORDER SIBLINGS BY MENU_SEQ

SELECT T.MENU_ID, T.MENU_PARENT_ID, T.MENU_TYPE, T.MENU_NAME, T.MENU_CODE, T.MENU_URL, T.MENU_SEQ, T.MENU_ICON, T.DISPLAY_FLAG, T.STATUS_CODE, (SELECT COUNT(MENU_ID) FROM OP_MENU WHERE MENU_PARENT_ID = T.MENU_ID) AS MENU_CHILD, SUBSTRING(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(MENU_NAME, '> '), 8) AS MENU_PATH FROM OP_MENU T WHERE MENU_PARENT_ID IS NOT NULL START WITH T.MENU_ID = '0' CONNECT BY PRIOR T.MENU_ID = T.MENU_PARENT_ID ORDER SIBLINGS BY T.MENU_SEQ

SELECT T.MENU_ID, T.MENU_PARENT_ID, T.MENU_TYPE, T.MENU_NAME, T.MENU_CODE, T.MENU_URL, T.MENU_SEQ, T.DISPLAY_FLAG, T.STATUS_CODE, (SELECT COUNT(MENU_ID) FROM OP_MENU_SELLER WHERE MENU_PARENT_ID = T.MENU_ID) AS MENU_CHILD, SUBSTRING(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(MENU_NAME, '> '), 8) AS MENU_PATH FROM OP_MENU_SELLER T WHERE MENU_PARENT_ID IS NOT NULL START WITH T.MENU_ID = '0' CONNECT BY PRIOR T.MENU_ID = T.MENU_PARENT_ID ORDER SIBLINGS BY T.MENU_SEQ

choose.when: SELECT MENU_ID, MENU_PARENT_ID, MENU_TYPE, MENU_NAME, MENU_CODE, MENU_URL, MENU_SEQ, MENU_ICON, DISPLAY_FLAG, STATUS_CODE, T.MENU_PAGE_CONTENT FROM OP_MENU T WHERE MENU_ID = #{menuId}
SELECT MENU_ID, MENU_PARENT_ID, MENU_TYPE, MENU_NAME, MENU_CODE, MENU_URL, MENU_SEQ, DISPLAY_FLAG, STATUS_CODE, T.MENU_PAGE_CONTENT FROM OP_MENU_SELLER T WHERE MENU_ID = #{menuId}

mapper.update: UPDATE SET MENU_NAME = #{menuName}, MENU_CODE = #{menuCode}, MENU_URL = #{menuUrl}, MENU_SEQ = #{menuSeq}, DISPLAY_FLAG = #{displayFlag}, STATUS_CODE = #{statusCode} WHERE MENU_ID = #{menuId}

SELECT MENU_ID, MENU_NAME FROM WHERE MENU_PARENT_ID = #{menuParentId} ORDER BY MENU_SEQ
